description: This file is a shell test script that verifies the behavior of the 'git clone' command, particularly how it calls 'git-upload-pack' under different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with setup commands to prepare environment.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to test error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or strings to expected values.
